results.title: I'm burned out and overworked and my bosses keep piling more ...
results.content: Despite talking with all bosses at least 3 times using things I’ve read on AAM, I’m still getting about 100 hours of work assigned to me weekly.*. It’s worked for about a week and then I get an email telling me to stop doing Y immediately and do Z because that’s the new priority. The key is to be really vigilant about “okay, that means I will stop work on Y for the foreseeable future” and generally just be super firm about announcing what you can/cannot do in 40 hours a week (or whatever) and sticking to it. – “So to make sure we’re all on the same page, I will focus on Z for the next week, which means that I won’t be working on X and Y.”. If you’re not firm about saying those things and sticking to them, then you’re enabling this terrible set-up by giving in and working too many hours/taking on too much stress, which you’re doing because you’re conscientious.
